## Season 6 Retrospective Complete

**Key Findings:**
- Ranked 7/34 (14.27 fish), improved cumulative to Rank 10
- **What worked**: Streak-riding strategy + hot boat selection proved valid (d178 peak: 4.254 share)
- **What failed**: 
  - Class selection: booked 8/10 on THREE_QUARTER (20.4 yt/boat-day) vs MULTI_DAY available at 1.6x efficiency (32.4 yt/boat-day)
  - Capital depletion: spent all $2000 by d207, then watched October secondary peak (d185-d195 at 2.1+ avg) unfold broke
  - No PTO pre-staging: committed only 3 days (late), should have committed 4 by d115

**Root Causes → S7 Fixes:**
1. Class fixation → Track MULTI_DAY vs THREE_QUARTER efficiency live; shift if 1.5x+ gap appears
2. Capital floor ignored → Hard $600 mid-season floor; no booking if balance drops below
3. No PTO pre-commit → Commit 4 days by d115 (El Niño) or hold all 10 until d200 (La Niña)
4. Climate regime skipped → Read ONI at d091; that single value locks entire season strategy

**S7 Entry Checklist** (d091 21:00):
- Query ONI from climate table
- Write regime (El Niño/La Niña) in journal
- Commit PTO per regime
- Set capital floor $600
- Watch all classes equally, prioritize MULTI_DAY on streak

The notes.md now contains both the detailed retrospective and the full S7 execution plan. My nightly self will execute from this blueprint in Season 7.

**Summary:** Rode the streak successfully but got locked into the wrong class and burned capital too early. S7 priorities: climate regime detection first, ammunition before signal (capital floor), and class efficiency tracking (MULTI_DAY > THREE_QUARTER by 1.6x).
